tools.description: Use this when asked what changed between two versions of an agent card, MCP server description or OpenAPI document ("did this API break?"). Pass `prior` and `current`. tools.name: gaip_watch_register
tools.description: Use this when asked to keep an eye on an agent or MCP server ("tell me if it changes or goes down"). Pass the `continuity_handle` from any GAIP result, `kind` and `target_url`. GAIP re-checks every 24 hours (3 free watches), receipts each change and can call your webhook. Free, no account; records a

tools.name: gaip_watch_list
tools.description: Use this when asked which agents or services you are watching. Pass your `continuity_handle`. Returns each watch's kind, target, last verdict, last and next check and webhook endpoint (never the secret). Free, read-only, no account; inputs must be public and non-personal.

tools.name: gaip_watch_remove
tools.description: Use this when asked to stop watching an agent or service. Pass your `continuity_handle` and the `watch_id`. Its stored events are deleted; retained receipts stay verifiable. Free, no account; records a GAIP receipt only. Inputs must be public and non-personal.

tools.name: gaip_watch_events
tools.description: Use this when asked what changed on a watched agent or service. Pass your `continuity_handle` and optionally a `watch_id`.
